summary: NCS Multistage Holdings (target) filed an 8-K announcing a definitive merger agreement with Weatherford International (acquirer) via a merger sub. Under the terms, each NCS share may be exchanged for either 0.5537 Weatherford ordinary shares (share consideration) or a mixed consideration of cash equivalent to 0.1371 shares plus 0.2392 shares. The NCS board unanimously approved the deal. Closing is expected in H2 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competing bids; risk-arb spread will hinge on Weatherford's share price.
